gen-nixie-one-gf-noto-znamenny-musical-n: Noto Znamenny Musical Notation keeps its terminals far from the stem. Nixie One draws its heading letters like cut ribbon of constant width, a nostalgic, retro-tech touch that gives the modern sans-serif text beneath it room to work.
gen-nixie-one-gf-overpass: Overpass reads sharp and steady, its e shapes never clogging into blots. Give the nostalgic Nixie One heading, drawn with a constant stroke, generous size, and let the Overpass text stay modest beneath it.
gen-nixie-one-gf-palanquin: Nostalgic and retro-tech, Nixie One holds its thickness steady right around every curve. Palanquin, a contemporary sans-serif, has curved letters with wide, unclosed mouths, so the text below the heading feels open and unhurried.
gen-nixie-one-gf-philosopher: Philosopher is plain sans at heart, with daylight inside its curves and soft shifts from heavy to light strokes. Page after page reads gently, and Nixie One's horizontals match its verticals.
gen-nixie-one-gf-pontano-sans: Contemporary at heart, Pontano Sans swings its c endings wide beneath Nixie One, whose strokes hold the steadiness of a drawn string. Text in it moves along smoothly, never snagging.
gen-nixie-one-gf-pt-sans: Nixie One draws nostalgic, retro-tech letters with no hairlines anywhere, just a constant stroke. PT Sans is the approachable one for text, its c forms reading as open arcs where the heading simply makes an entrance.
gen-nixie-one-gf-quattrocento-sans: Quattrocento Sans is a modern plain sans, clean enough that each c keeps a gap and never turns into an o. Nixie One brings blueprint-lettering lines; the body does the reading.
gen-nixie-one-gf-red-hat-text: Modern and approachable, Red Hat Text draws its curvy letters loose, with the line weight of a technical drawing pen. And under Nixie One's nostalgic headings, this sans-serif keeps a long run of text moving without a snag.
gen-nixie-one-gf-rethink-sans: Rethink Sans is approachable and modern, its openings staying generous at every weight. Rethink Sans can stand a slightly larger size beside Nixie One's constant-stroke heading, which keeps its nostalgic retro-tech look.
gen-nixie-one-gf-rosario: Single-wire nostalgia up top: Nixie One looks bent from one strand, with open curves and clear gaps. Rosario, a contemporary plain sans, keeps the ends of the c from ever turning inward, so the two sit comfortably together.
